user.title: COROS Training Hub
user.description: Connect your COROS account to sync your workouts, health metrics and calendar. Email/password syncs activities and schedules. The optional MCP token is required for EvoLab metrics (threshold pace, VO2max, recovery, race predictions, sleep).

init.title: COROS Options
init.description: COROS synchronization settings. To enable or update EvoLab and recovery metrics, generate your token with `python tools/get_mcp_token.py` and paste it below.
